positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer on the Android Systems team at Google. Working on hardware-backed authentication, device performance optimization, and theft protection.

positions.title: CS106 Section Leader
positions.description: Gained valuable debugging and communication skills teaching section for Stanford's introductory programming courses (CS106A/B/X).  Developed a passion for teaching computer science while strengthening my knowledge of fundamental concepts ranging from memory management to dynamic programming.

positions.title: AI Lab Research Assistant
positions.description: Assisted in developing and implementing Computer Vision algorithms for Professor Andrew Ng's Lab. Adapted research vision algorithms to audio data to perform phoneme recognition.

positions.title: Research Assistant - Army High Performance Computing Research Center
positions.description: Implemented algorithms with to test the performance of a heterogeneous computing model consisting of CUDA and MPI. Gained experience with scientific computing on large-scale clusters and optimizing massively parallel code.

positions.title: Test Platform Software Developer
positions.description: Began development on a distributed testing platform to simulate solar panel energy production and environmental conditions from a large number of nodes. Modeled and simulated large numbers of solar panel data gateways in different conditions. Developed software to manage, process, and 				communicate large quantities of data.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed the website for the Stanford Chapter of the Student Society for Stem Cell Research.
